title: West / Central San Jose：Valley Fair、医院与 Bascom 走廊
title_en: West / Central San Jose: Valley Fair, the hospitals and the Bascom corridor
intro: 95128 位于 San Jose 西部和中部之间，I-280 与 I-880 在这一带交汇，Stevens Creek Blvd、Winchester Blvd 和 Bascom Ave 是主要道路。Santana Row 和 Westfield Valley Fair 在北侧，Santa Clara Valley Medical Center 和 O'Connor Hospital 也都在这个邮编内，购物和医疗比多数住宅片区集中。住房类型混合：Santana Row 周边是较新的公寓，主路沿线有公寓和联排，住宅街区则以独立屋为主。同一邮编内房型差别很大，还夹着县辖地块，比较时要细到街道。
intro_en: 95128 sits between West and Central San Jose, where I-280 meets I-880, with Stevens Creek Blvd, Winchester Blvd and Bascom Ave as the main roads. Santana Row and Westfield Valley Fair are on the north side, and Santa Clara Valley Medical Center and O’Connor Hospital are both in this ZIP code, so shopping and medical care are closer at hand than in most residential areas. Housing is mixed: newer condos around Santana Row, condos and townhomes along the main roads, and mostly single-family homes on the residential streets. With that range, plus pockets of unincorporated county land, comparisons need to go down to the street.
buyer: 先确认地址在市界内还是县辖地块：Bascom Ave 沿线的 Burbank 是被 San Jose 包围的非建制社区，许可和市政服务走县政府。学校涉及 Campbell Union SD、Luther Burbank SD 和 Campbell Union HSD 等，请按完整地址向学区核实。买公寓要看车位归属、HOA 月费、储备金和特别摊派；靠近 Valley Fair、I-280 的街道要在周末和高峰各看一次车流。
buyer_en: First confirm whether the address is inside city limits or on county land. Burbank, along Bascom Ave, is an unincorporated community surrounded by San Jose, and permits and services there go through the county. Schools here involve Campbell Union SD, Luther Burbank SD and Campbell Union HSD among others, so confirm the full address with the district. For condos, check the assigned parking, HOA dues, reserves and special assessments. Near Valley Fair and I-280, see the traffic on a weekend and at rush hour.
seller: 公寓、联排和独立屋不能混在一起定价，Santana Row 周边的公寓也要和其他路段的公寓分开看。县辖地块和市辖街道的许可记录要分别整理。市府 2017 年批准了 Santana Row/Valley Fair、Winchester 和 Stevens Creek 三个 Urban Village 规划，买家问到周边变化时，以市府公开资料回答。
seller_en: Condos, townhomes and single-family homes should not be priced together, and condos near Santana Row belong in a different set from those elsewhere in the ZIP code. Gather permit records from the right agency, county or city, depending on the parcel. The city approved Urban Village plans for Santana Row/Valley Fair, Winchester and Stevens Creek in 2017, so when buyers ask about changes nearby, answer from the city’s published information.
